caption: Isola Bella, Stresa
composition: Borromean Isola Bella palace and terraced gardens on Lago Maggiore · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The island fills the center of the frame from the lake, its terraced gardens rising in green steps on the left, studded with cypresses and pale statues, while the white Baroque palace stands at the right with its ornate roofline. The stone landing terrace juts into the water at the lower left, and hazy blue mountains ring the lake behind. At 09:11 the morning light is bright and clear, and the lake is calm and deep blue.
